name: Dual-Read Characterization
description: Run both SQLite and PGlite side-by-side during reads. Compare results. Characterize every divergence.
purpose: Prove PGlite returns identical results before cutting over writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Read path is instrumented to query both SQLite and PGlite
Results are compared field-by-field for every query
Divergences are logged with full detail for analysis
Characterization report documents every divergence found
